identity: ONE original tall slim robed conjurer, the Lattice Conjurer veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the layered ivory, navy and gold robes with long hanging panels, the face completely hidden in darkness inside a tall pointed prismatic blue-violet mitre helmet with a delicate gold geometric frame and small hanging diamond crystals, gold gauntlets over black gloves and pointed dark navy boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands hold ONE long dark staff diagonally across the body, a small diamond pommel at the lower screen-left end and a large open gold geometric cage around a blue-violet crystal at the upper screen-right end with hanging diamond pendants. Preserve the full staff, the mitre helmet, the hidden face and the slim adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep both ends of the staff, the mitre, the robes, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, beams, projectiles, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the crystals keep only their steady glow, and only the caged crystal may brighten where the action says so. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the staff.

idle_h3_v1.action: A composed, scholarly idle that loops. The conjurer breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the staff is lifted a little so the caged crystal and its pendants sway, the mitred head tilts slightly as if studying, the robes stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no casting. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with measured, gliding steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate under the robes and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The staff is carried diagonally in both hands; the robe panels swing with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE staff strike toward screen right. The conjurer raises the staff high and back as the knees bend, then lunges forward and drives the caged crystal head out level to full reach at screen right, draws it back and returns to the original diagonal stance. One strike only; no flash or effect at contact.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Make ONE ranged thrust toward screen right. The conjurer braces and draws the staff back, then thrusts it forward level with the caged crystal pointing at screen right, holds, then the staff lowers and the conjurer settles into the original stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

hit_h3_v1.action: The conjurer starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The shoulders hunch and twist away, the mitre tips and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the staff, then the conjurer straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Raise the staff horizontally in both hands in front of the chest as a barrier, bend the knees wide and crouch behind it with the mitred head lowered, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: An invocation. The conjurer releases one hand from the staff and extends it open, palm up toward screen right, while the staff stays upright in the other hand and the caged crystal glows a little warmer, holds the gesture briefly, then returns the hand to the staff in the original stance. Only the caged crystal brightens; no aura, rune or spell effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly from standing. The conjurer sags, leans on the staff and sinks onto the knees, stays kneeling a moment, then slumps forward onto the side and lies down, finishing motionless flat on the ground with the mitre at screen right and the boots at screen left, the staff lying beside the body. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.

death_h3_v2.action: Collapse slowly from standing. The conjurer sags, leans on the staff and sinks onto the knees, stays kneeling a moment, then slumps forward onto the side and lies down, finishing motionless flat on the ground with the mitre at screen right and the boots at screen left, the staff lying beside the body. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
